//: Digging (Prologue rule, 04.10.2026). Code: src/game/world/Digging.js. The tile's menu offers Dig on open ground; what comes up depends on where the survivor stands: `shore` ground on a hex of `shoreTerrains` or next to one of `shoreNeighbours`, otherwise the ground named for the terrain in `terrains`; a terrain not listed cannot be dug. One dig takes `minutes` with a tool of `quality` at `level`; a better digging tool is faster (`speed`, by level, Prologue's own dial). The work is kept on the hex when it stops for breath. `yields` rows give `count` (or `charges` for things counted by charges) and an optional `chance`. Times, tool level, quantities and the effort (`activity`) are CDDA's.
